```{=html}
<!-- Interactive Figure 2: square-root trajectories. Static SVG inlined verbatim from trajectories_figure.py (figures/fig2-simplex-root/simplex-root-d3.svg); the three baked default trajectories are the no-JS baseline. The script only ADDS the orange user trajectory and updates the readout. It reads the simplex vertices from the polygon (single source of truth) and uses the locked root S (kept in sync with the generator). -->
<style>
.trajectory-interactive{max-width:520px;margin:1.25rem auto;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}
.trajectory-interactive svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;cursor:crosshair;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-readout{margin-top:1rem;padding:0.9rem 1.1rem;background:#f4f6f8;border:1px solid #e2e8ee;border-radius:10px;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-head-label{font-size:13px;color:#3a5a72;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-hint{font-size:13px;color:#9aa9b5;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-hint.is-set{color:#a8651a;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px 1fr;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-key{font-family:ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:13px;color:#a8651a;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-vec{font-family:ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:14px;color:#9aa9b5;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-vec.is-set{color:#1a3550;}
.trajectory-interactive .tr-vh{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);border:0;}
</style>

<div class="trajectory-interactive">
  <p class="tr-vh">Interactive square-root trajectories on the probability simplex. Three default trajectories are shown: the pure states e1, e2, e3 each reach the uniform distribution in two steps, with e1 and e2 merging at the same intermediate point. Click inside the triangle to trace your own starting distribution and read off its two images under the root S.</p>

<svg role="img" aria-label="Square-root trajectories on the probability simplex" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 620" font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowP" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5"
            markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#5a2d7a"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrowT" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5"
            markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#3a7a7a"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Simplex (triangular face) -->
  <polygon points="140.0,510.0 540.0,430.0 310.0,130.0"
           fill="#a8c5d8" fill-opacity="0.55"
           stroke="#1a3550" stroke-width="2.2"
           stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Medians -->
  <g stroke="#1a3550" stroke-width="0.9" stroke-opacity="0.22" stroke-dasharray="4,5">
    <line x1="140.0" y1="510.0" x2="425.0" y2="280.0"/>
    <line x1="540.0" y1="430.0" x2="225.0" y2="320.0"/>
    <line x1="310.0" y1="130.0" x2="340.0" y2="470.0"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Step-1 arrows (purple): two converge at q_a -->
  <line x1="147.3" y1="501.7" x2="254.7" y2="379.8" stroke="#5a2d7a" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" marker-end="url(#arrowP)"/>
  <line x1="529.2" y1="427.7" x2="276.0" y2="372.8" stroke="#5a2d7a" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" marker-end="url(#arrowP)"/>
  <line x1="316.7" y1="138.7" x2="455.4" y2="319.7" stroke="#5a2d7a" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" marker-end="url(#arrowP)"/>

  <!-- Step-2 arrows (teal): only two leave -->
  <line x1="274.1" y1="367.8" x2="317.3" y2="359.2" stroke="#3a7a7a" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" marker-end="url(#arrowT)"/>
  <line x1="452.5" y1="332.2" x2="342.7" y2="354.1" stroke="#3a7a7a" stroke-width="2.0" stroke-linecap="round" marker-end="url(#arrowT)"/>

  <!-- Intermediate points q_a, q_b (teal) -->
  <circle cx="263.3" cy="370.0" r="7.0" fill="#3a7a7a"/>
  <circle cx="463.3" cy="330.0" r="5.5" fill="#3a7a7a"/>

  <!-- Starting points e1, e2, e3 (purple) -->
  <circle cx="140.0" cy="510.0" r="6.0" fill="#5a2d7a"/>
  <circle cx="540.0" cy="430.0" r="6.0" fill="#5a2d7a"/>
  <circle cx="310.0" cy="130.0" r="6.0" fill="#5a2d7a"/>

  <!-- Uniform distribution p0 (red) -->
  <circle cx="330.0" cy="356.7" r="6.5" fill="#c0392b"/>

  <!-- Vertex labels (purple) + probability vectors (muted) -->
  <text x="132.0" y="536.0" text-anchor="end" font-size="21" font-style="italic" fill="#5a2d7a">e₁</text>
  <text x="132.0" y="554.0" text-anchor="end" font-size="13" fill="#3a5a72">(1, 0, 0)</text>
  <text x="556.0" y="438.0" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" font-style="italic" fill="#5a2d7a">e₂</text>
  <text x="556.0" y="456.0" text-anchor="start" font-size="13" fill="#3a5a72">(0, 1, 0)</text>
  <text x="310.0" y="102.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" font-style="italic" fill="#5a2d7a">e₃</text>
  <text x="310.0" y="120.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#3a5a72">(0, 0, 1)</text>

  <!-- Intermediate labels (teal) -->
  <text x="261.3" y="357.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-style="italic" fill="#3a7a7a">q<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="0.72em" font-style="italic">a</tspan></text>
  <text x="475.3" y="335.0" text-anchor="start" font-size="15" font-style="italic" fill="#3a7a7a">q<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="0.72em" font-style="italic">b</tspan></text>

  <!-- p0 label (red dot, dark label) -->
  <text x="343.0" y="352.7" text-anchor="start" font-size="21" font-style="italic" fill="#1a3550">p₀</text>
  <text x="343.0" y="370.7" text-anchor="start" font-size="13" fill="#3a5a72">(⅓, ⅓, ⅓)</text>
</svg>

  <div class="tr-readout">
    <div class="tr-head">
      <span class="tr-head-label">Your trajectory under S</span>
      <span class="tr-hint" data-tr="hint">click inside the triangle</span>
    </div>
    <div class="tr-rows">
      <div class="tr-row"><span class="tr-key">&rho;&#8320;</span><span class="tr-vec" data-tr="v0">&#8212;</span></div>
      <div class="tr-row"><span class="tr-key">S&#8202;&rho;&#8320;</span><span class="tr-vec" data-tr="v1">&#8212;</span></div>
      <div class="tr-row"><span class="tr-key">S&sup2;&#8202;&rho;&#8320;</span><span class="tr-vec" data-tr="v2">&#8212;</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  function setup(root) {
    var svg = root.querySelector('svg');
    if (!svg) return;
    var poly = svg.querySelector('polygon');
    if (!poly) return;
    var pts = poly.getAttribute('points').trim().split(/\s+/).map(function (p) {
      var c = p.split(','); return { x: parseFloat(c[0]), y: parseFloat(c[1]) };
    });
    if (pts.length < 3) return;
    var V1 = pts[0], V2 = pts[1], V3 = pts[2];   // polygon order: e1, e2, e3

    var det = (V2.y - V3.y) * (V1.x - V3.x) + (V3.x - V2.x) * (V1.y - V3.y);
    function bary(px, py) {
      var b1 = ((V2.y - V3.y) * (px - V3.x) + (V3.x - V2.x) * (py - V3.y)) / det;
      var b2 = ((V3.y - V1.y) * (px - V3.x) + (V1.x - V3.x) * (py - V3.y)) / det;
      return [b1, b2, 1 - b1 - b2];
    }
    function toCanvas(p) {
      return [p[0]*V1.x + p[1]*V2.x + p[2]*V3.x, p[0]*V1.y + p[1]*V2.y + p[2]*V3.y];
    }
    // The root S; must match trajectories_figure.py. S^2 = P.
    var S = [[1/2, 1/2, 0], [1/6, 1/6, 2/3], [1/3, 1/3, 1/3]];
    function applyS(p) {
      return [
        S[0][0]*p[0] + S[0][1]*p[1] + S[0][2]*p[2],
        S[1][0]*p[0] + S[1][1]*p[1] + S[1][2]*p[2],
        S[2][0]*p[0] + S[2][1]*p[1] + S[2][2]*p[2]
      ];
    }
    function toSvg(evt) {
      var pt = svg.createSVGPoint(); pt.x = evt.clientX; pt.y = evt.clientY;
      var m = svg.getScreenCTM(); if (!m) return null;
      var l = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse()); return [l.x, l.y];
    }

    var NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
    function el(t, a) { var e = document.createElementNS(NS, t); for (var k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]); return e; }

    var defs = svg.querySelector('defs') || svg.insertBefore(el('defs', {}), svg.firstChild);
    var mk = el('marker', { id: 'arrowO', viewBox: '0 0 10 10', refX: '9', refY: '5', markerWidth: '7', markerHeight: '7', orient: 'auto-start-reverse' });
    mk.appendChild(el('path', { d: 'M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z', fill: '#d4882f' }));
    defs.appendChild(mk);

    var hover = el('circle', { r: 5, fill: '#d4882f', 'fill-opacity': '0.45', 'pointer-events': 'none', opacity: '0' });
    svg.appendChild(hover);
    var layer = el('g', { 'pointer-events': 'none' });   // the additive user trajectory
    svg.appendChild(layer);

    function shorten(a, b, ts, te) {
      var dx = b[0]-a[0], dy = b[1]-a[1], L = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
      if (L < ts + te + 1e-6) return [a, b];
      var ux = dx/L, uy = dy/L;
      return [[a[0]+ts*ux, a[1]+ts*uy], [b[0]-te*ux, b[1]-te*uy]];
    }
    function arrow(a, b) {
      var s = shorten(a, b, 11, 12);
      return el('line', { x1: s[0][0], y1: s[0][1], x2: s[1][0], y2: s[1][1], stroke: '#d4882f', 'stroke-width': '2', 'stroke-linecap': 'round', 'marker-end': 'url(#arrowO)' });
    }

    var hint = root.querySelector('[data-tr="hint"]');
    var vEls = [root.querySelector('[data-tr="v0"]'), root.querySelector('[data-tr="v1"]'), root.querySelector('[data-tr="v2"]')];
    function fmt(p) { function f(x){ var n = Math.round(x*100)/100; if (n === 0) n = 0; return n.toFixed(2); } return '(' + f(p[0]) + ', ' + f(p[1]) + ', ' + f(p[2]) + ')'; }

    function clearLayer() { while (layer.firstChild) layer.removeChild(layer.firstChild); }
    function reset() {
      clearLayer();
      hint.textContent = 'click inside the triangle'; hint.classList.remove('is-set');
      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { vEls[i].textContent = '—'; vEls[i].classList.remove('is-set'); }
    }
    function show(b, c0) {
      clearLayer();
      var s1 = applyS(b), s2 = applyS(s1);
      var c1 = toCanvas(s1), c2 = toCanvas(s2);
      layer.appendChild(arrow(c0, c1));
      layer.appendChild(arrow(c1, c2));
      layer.appendChild(el('circle', { cx: c1[0], cy: c1[1], r: 5.5, fill: '#d4882f' }));
      layer.appendChild(el('circle', { cx: c2[0], cy: c2[1], r: 5, fill: '#d4882f' }));
      var sq = 9;   // rho0 as a square: a user-placed point, distinct from the round dots
      layer.appendChild(el('rect', { x: c0[0]-sq/2, y: c0[1]-sq/2, width: sq, height: sq, fill: '#d4882f', stroke: '#9c5d16', 'stroke-width': '1.5' }));
      var vals = [b, s1, s2];
      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { vEls[i].textContent = fmt(vals[i]); vEls[i].classList.add('is-set'); }
      hint.textContent = 'two steps to p₀'; hint.classList.add('is-set');
    }

    var EPS = -1e-6;
    function inside(b) { return b[0] >= EPS && b[1] >= EPS && b[2] >= EPS; }

    svg.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
      if (e.pointerType && e.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;
      var loc = toSvg(e); if (!loc) return;
      var b = bary(loc[0], loc[1]);
      if (inside(b)) { hover.setAttribute('cx', loc[0]); hover.setAttribute('cy', loc[1]); hover.setAttribute('opacity', '1'); }
      else hover.setAttribute('opacity', '0');
    });
    svg.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () { hover.setAttribute('opacity', '0'); });
    svg.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var loc = toSvg(e); if (!loc) return;
      var b = bary(loc[0], loc[1]);
      if (inside(b)) show(b, loc); else reset();
    });
  }
  function init() {
    var roots = document.querySelectorAll('.trajectory-interactive');
    for (var i = 0; i < roots.length; i++) setup(roots[i]);
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>
```
